result.summary: 本文提出了“精度感知”的缩放定律，将训练精度和训练后量化精度纳入损失预测，核心思想是低精度会降低模型的有效参数量 N_eff [S1.p2]。作者在 465 次预训练运行上拟合，覆盖 3 到 16 比特精度，并在最多 1.7B 参数、26B token 的模型上验证预测 [abstract]。研究发现训练后量化的退化随数据量增加，因此对固定模型而言，若之后要量化，额外预训练数据在某一节点后可能反而有害 [S1.p3]；同时，训练更大模型于更低精度可能是计算最优的 [abstract]。作者将训练与推理的缩放定律统一为单一函数形式，并指出 16 比特训练和追求极低（低于 4 比特）预训练精度都可能不是最优的 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要回答的问题是：精度、参数量和数据之间存在怎样的权衡，以及这些权衡在预训练和推理时有何不同 [S1.p1]。研究动机在于，精度是影响模型成本和性能的第三个重要因素，而当前的缩放定律并未考虑这一点 [abstract]；深度学习正趋向更低精度，如 Llama-3 系列用 BF16 训练、社区推动 FP8 预训练，下一代硬件将支持 FP4 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: What are the tradeoffs between precision, parameters, and data? How do they compare for pretraining and inference?
Low precision training and inference affect both the quality and cost of language models, but current scaling laws do not account for this.
Deep learning is trending towards lower precision: current frontier models like the Llama-3 series are trained in BF16, and there is widespread effort to move the pretraining paradigm to FP8.
The next generation of hardware will support FP4, and advances in weight-only quantization have led to training in binary and ternary at scale.

method.text: 论文提出“精度感知”的缩放定律，假设比特精度和参数量可互换地贡献于模型的“有效参数量” N_eff，量化实现细节仅通过影响该量来与损失缩放交互 [S1.p2]。作者将训练时效应、数据效应和训练后量化退化统一为一个函数形式 L(N,D,P_train,P_post) [S1.p4]。对于预训练，作者将计算成本推广为 C=(6/16)NDP，以反映计算与精度的线性关系 [S4.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: This functional form that posits bit precision and parameter count interchangeably contribute to a model’s “effective parameter count,” $N_{\text{eff}}$, and implementation details like which parts of a model are quantized to what precision, interact with loss scaling only through their effect on this quantity.

we ultimately find a unified scaling law that takes the following form: $L(N,D,P_{\text{train}},P_{\text{post}})=\underbrace{\underbrace{AN_{\text{eff}}^{-\alpha}}_{\text{Training-time Effects}}+BD^{-\beta}+E}_{\text{Usual Chinchilla form}}+\underbrace{\delta_{\text{PTQ}}(N_{\text{eff}},D,P_{\text{train}},P_{\text{post}})}_{\text{Post-Training Effects}}$
We generalize this to $C=\frac{6}{16}NDP$ to account for the linear relation between compute and precision, which reduces to the Chinchilla cost function for $P=16$.

experiments.text: 作者在 465 次预训练运行上拟合缩放定律，覆盖 3 到 16 比特精度，并将每个模型训练后量化到多种精度 [S1.p4]。实验使用标准因果 Transformer++ 架构，在 Dolma 数据集的 common crawl 划分上训练和验证，序列长度 1024、批量大小 256 [A1.p1]。训练精度扫描覆盖权重、激活和 KV 缓存的 P_w, P_a, P_kv ∈ [3,12]，并包含 BF16 基线 [S4.p1]。验证规模达到最多 1.7B 参数、26B token [abstract]，并在 220M 到 1.6B 参数、FP4 到 FP32 的模型上测试预测 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: In all, we pretrain a suite of 465 language models in 3 to 16 bit precisions, as well as post-train quantize each to multiple precisions.
We launch over 20 runs for each $(N,D)$ combination to study scaling in precision, trained and validated on the common crawl split of the Dolma dataset.
We use a sequence length of 1024 and batch size of 256 throughout
We sweep the training precisions of the weights, activations, and KV cache $P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}}\in[3,12]$ individually, as well as training BF16 baselines.
We fit on over 465 pretraining runs and validate our predictions on model sizes up to 1.7B parameters trained on up to 26B tokens.
We train compute-matched models at various parameter count and precision ranging from FP4 to FP32 and 220M to 1.6B parameters.

findings.text: 训练后量化引入的退化随数据量增加，因此对固定模型而言，若之后要量化，在某一节点后继续用额外数据训练可能反而有害 [S1.p3]。权重比特精度可与参数量权衡，即较小 N 但较大 P_w 的模型能达到与较大 N 但较小 P_w 相同的损失，且精度增益在低精度时大、在约 6-7 比特后饱和 [S4.SS1.p1]。计算最优预训练精度通常与计算预算无关 [S1.p3]，但如果模型大小 N 被约束，计算最优精度随计算量缓慢增长，P*(C) ∝ log C [S4.SS3.SSS3.p1]。统一缩放定律在超过 1000 个数据点上拟合得到 R²=0.90 [S5.p6]，且训练精度更低的模型对训练后量化更鲁棒，即退化更低 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: We find that the degradation increases with data, so that for a fixed model, training on additional data after a certain point can be actively harmful if the model will be quantized after training.

We observe that the bit precision of the weights can be traded off for the number of parameters, i.e., a model with smaller $N$ but larger $P_{\text{w}}$ can achieve the same loss as a model with larger $N$ but smaller $P_{\text{w}}$.
Additionally, we find that the gains from increasing the bit precision of the weights are large at lower precisions but saturate at higher precisions (typically around 6-7 bits per weight).
Our scaling laws for pretraining suggest that the compute-optimal pretraining precision is in general independent of compute budget.
Surprisingly, our scaling laws predict that models of differing sizes should not necessarily be trained in the same precision, and that compute-optimal precision scales as $P^{*}(C)\propto\log C$.
We measure the fit to the data of such a functional form in Figure 7, and find a strong fit with $R^{2}=0.90$ on over 1000 data points

We find two competing effects at play when predicting $\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$, but overall, models trained in lower precision are more robust to post-train quantization in the sense of incurring lower degradation.

limitations.text: 作者承认分析存在局限：全程使用固定架构来受控地考察精度、参数和 token 的影响，而低精度训练常涉及架构调整，可缩小与普通全精度模型的差距 [S6.p2]。其次，虽然计算成本随精度线性缩放，但由于系统开销，精度减半带来的收益通常不到 2 倍 [S6.p2]。第三，只考虑损失缩放，未进行下游模型评估 [S6.p2]。作者强调所发现的趋势旨在提示而非规定，并希望未来工作能在更大模型规模上更全面地检验这些效应 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner. In contrast, low precision training often involves architectural tweaks that can close much of the gap from a vanilla full precision model.
Second, while compute costs do scale linearly with precision, the gains from halving precision are usually less than 2x due to systems overhead.
Third, we only consider loss scaling without downstream model evaluations.
We emphasize that the trends we find aim to be suggestive rather than prescriptive, and hope future work can more comprehensively examine these effects at larger model scale.
